sources.entry: Halo - A powerful and easy-to-use website building tool (documentation in Chinese). (Demo, Source Code, Clients) GPL-3.0 Java/Docker

summary.one_liner: Halo is an open-source website building tool (Java, with Docker images) for blogs, knowledge bases, corporate sites, and online stores, with documentation in Chinese.
summary.what_it_does: The README describes Halo as an open-source site builder covering personal blogs, knowledge bases, corporate websites, and online shops. It offers a one-line Docker command to start a trial instance on port 8090 with data persisted to a local directory. The README recommends deploying with the 1Panel server management panel for reverse proxy, SSL certificates, and upgrade/backup tasks. It also describes three editions: a free Community edition (GPLv3) with themes and plugins, and paid Professional and Mall editions that add features such as a mobile app, AI site generation, phone-number login, and a commercial store with WeChat Pay and Alipay integration. An app marketplace and developer publishing are mentioned, along with an awesome-halo list maintained under halo-sigs.
use_cases: create a knowledge base or documentation site
try a self-hosted CMS with Docker
notable: Community edition is free under GPLv3 with over 100 free themes and plugins
Official Docker image for quick trial setup
Recommends 1Panel for reverse proxy, SSL and backups
Has an app marketplace and developer publishing support
caveats: Professional and Mall editions with mobile app, AI site builder, and online store features are paid, and the README does not state their prices
The one-line Docker command is described as for trial use only
README is primarily in Chinese; English documentation is not mentioned
